nodes.label: Predeclared Physical Target Domain and Admission Rule
nodes.statement: A target claim fixes before outcomes the physically admissible context domain T, an admission rule with bearer/time/sort/realization provenance, and—only for mean or mass claims—an independently justified probability measure mu; observed samples, task labels and post-hoc exclusions do not define T or mu.
nodes.domain: One named R168-R169 effect application and its intended physical context population.
nodes.scope: One named R168-R169 effect application and its intended physical context population.
nodes.source_lineage: UCT-I physical-witness discipline and R169 actual-node identity, extended to target-domain admission and measure typing.
nodes.proof: Contract definition; every quantitative conclusion requires the separately typed coverage premises below.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A convenience sample or laboratory distribution can omit a physically admissible safety-critical state; no canonical measure follows from T alone.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: actual target contexts and optional target measure
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every context quantified by the target claim; mu only where explicitly fixed
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same bearer lineage, consumer, timing, sort and realization identity as R169
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Prevent tested samples from silently becoming the full physical domain

nodes.label: Independently Bounded Cells with Actual Routes to Certified Anchors
nodes.statement: Each certified cell has an independently bounded physical admission range, an actual R169 anchor, and a universal same-lineage route or structural channel budget R_j(z)<=r_j for every admitted context; sampled clouds, fitted interpolation and success-selected cells do not qualify.
nodes.domain: A finite family of physical cells inside one R170 target domain and one frozen R169 consumer geometry.
nodes.scope: A finite family of physical cells inside one R170 target domain and one frozen R169 consumer geometry.
nodes.source_lineage: R169 actual route and upper-budget contract plus a narrower universal range proof for continuum cells.
nodes.proof: For every admitted z, the R169 effect modulus transports the anchor envelope by at most 2R_j(z); overlapping valid cells may be minimized.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Endpoint checks do not bound an interior gate; proving a cell range is a universal structural obligation but need not reconstruct the full mechanism.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: actual continuum or finite cells and R169 anchors
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every context admitted by every used cell under one universal radius event
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same actual bearer lineage, consumer, pre-compensation interval and discriminator class
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Cover continuum interiors without pretending finite sampled nodes are dense enough

nodes.label: Covered Domain C and Unresolved Remainder U
nodes.statement: For the frozen target T and certified cells C_j, define C as their union and U=T\C; U remains part of the target and receives no route or cell conclusion unless a separate certificate applies.
nodes.domain: One common target-domain contract and cell family.
nodes.scope: One common target-domain contract and cell family.
nodes.source_lineage: Set decomposition attached to R169's domain-relative route boundary.
nodes.proof: C=union_j C_j and U=T minus C are disjoint and cover T by definition; physical correctness of membership remains a contract premise.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Relabeling failed challenges outside T after observation invalidates the target contract; U is not assumed empty or harmless.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: covered and unresolved actual target contexts
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every z in predeclared T belongs to exactly one of C or U
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same target identity and cell provenance
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Represent unknown contexts explicitly instead of assigning them zero effect

nodes.label: Certified Envelope on C and Range Cap M on U
nodes.statement: If e<=E_C on C and only 0<=e<=M is known on U, then the sharp pointwise envelope over exactly that information class equals E_C on C and M on U; no smaller pointwise upper follows without an added premise.
nodes.domain: One frozen bounded R168 effect, R169/cell envelope on C and explicit R170 remainder U.
nodes.scope: One frozen bounded R168 effect, R169/cell envelope on C and explicit R170 remainder U.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary case split and extremal envelope witness typed to the R168-R170 objects.
nodes.proof: Upper validity follows by cases; e=E_C on C and e=M on U attains the envelope within the stated information class.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Information-class sharpness is not a proof that every extremal function is realized by one consumer-law kernel family.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: bounded contextual effect and piecewise domain
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every z in T and every effect compatible with the declared pointwise premises
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same effect, target and simultaneous envelope-validity event
formal_contract_R170.purpose: State the strongest honest pointwise result under an explicit remainder

nodes.label: Any Nonempty Unbounded Remainder Preserves Supremum M
nodes.statement: If U is nonempty and has no separate amplitude bridge, the sharp general global bound is sup_T e<=M even when mu(U) is arbitrarily small or zero; a nontrivial global amplitude bound needs U empty or another pointwise certificate on U.
nodes.domain: Any R170 target with a nonempty unresolved remainder and inherited effect cap M.
nodes.scope: Any R170 target with a nonempty unresolved remainder and inherited effect cap M.
nodes.source_lineage: Extremal witness on the unresolved set; preserves R168's mass-versus-amplitude distinction.
nodes.proof: Set e=M at one unresolved context and any compatible values on C; its measure does not alter the pointwise supremum.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Almost-everywhere control is not pointwise control; excluding a null context requires a domain, continuity or amplitude premise.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: global amplitude over an open target domain
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every nonempty U without an added pointwise bound
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same target T; measure-independent pointwise statement
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Block small unknown mass from becoming small unknown amplitude

nodes.label: Sharp Mean Bound with Explicit Unknown Mass
nodes.statement: For a fixed justified target probability measure mu, integral_T e is at most integral_C E_C plus M mu(U); if E_C<=b and mu(U)<=epsilon, it is at most b+(M-b)epsilon, without any conclusion about sup_U e.
nodes.domain: One R170 target with fixed mu, valid covered envelope and explicit remainder.
nodes.scope: One R170 target with fixed mu, valid covered envelope and explicit remainder.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary integration of the sharp piecewise envelope.
nodes.proof: Integrate e<=E_C on C and e<=M on U; the sharp envelope witness attains equality in the information class.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A convenience measure, dependent confidence event or sample frequency without a sampling-frame proof cannot discharge mu(U)<=epsilon.

formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: mu-almost every z under one fixed target measure and simultaneous bound event
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same T, mu, effect and envelope validity event
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Permit honest average claims without pretending domain closure

nodes.label: Exceeded-Effect Mass Is Covered Exceedance Plus Remainder
nodes.statement: For tau<M, {e>tau} is contained in {z in C:E_C(z)>tau} union U, so its mu-mass is bounded by the covered-envelope exceedance mass plus mu(U), capped at one; this is not a maximum-effect bound.
nodes.domain: One fixed R170 target measure, threshold and valid pointwise covered envelope.
nodes.scope: One fixed R170 target measure, threshold and valid pointwise covered envelope.
nodes.source_lineage: Set inclusion applied to the R170 sharp piecewise envelope and R168 mass-only boundary.
nodes.proof: A covered point with e>tau must have E_C>tau; every other exceedance lies in U; take mu.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An epsilon-mass unresolved state may still have effect M; threshold and measure must be frozen.

formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every frozen tau<M and every compatible effect
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same T, mu, effect, threshold and validity event
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Separate affected mass from worst-case amplitude

nodes.label: Held-Out Boundary Contexts Can Refute Cell or Mass Coverage
nodes.statement: A predeclared held-out target context refutes a cell certificate if admission, route identity or budget fails, and refutes a remainder-mass certificate if valid target-frame evidence exceeds its frozen epsilon; neither refutation is a no-mediator, no-experience or anti-C1 result.
nodes.domain: One frozen target/cell/remainder plan and independently generated actual boundary challenges.
nodes.scope: One frozen target/cell/remainder plan and independently generated actual boundary challenges.
nodes.source_lineage: R169 held-out calibration falsifier extended from edge budgets to admission and remainder mass.
nodes.proof: A valid challenge violating a universal cell clause or simultaneous mass upper bound makes the corresponding certificate false.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Passing finitely many challenges does not prove an unbounded target complete; shared bias and post-hoc challenges invalidate the inference.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: held-out actual target contexts and frozen coverage claims
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: one valid violation refutes its certificate; no converse completeness inference
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same target, admission, consumer, timing and challenge frame
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Make open-world coverage rejectable rather than decorative

nodes.label: Invalid, Refuted, Closed-Amplitude, Open-Mass, or Unresolved
nodes.statement: Invalid target/admission/measure/measurement gives INVALID_OPEN_WORLD_PROTOCOL; a valid challenge violation gives COVERAGE_CERTIFICATE_REFUTED; proven empty remainder with valid envelopes gives CLOSED_DOMAIN_AMPLITUDE_CERTIFIED; valid mu(U)<=epsilon with retained amplitude M gives OPEN_WORLD_MASS_CERTIFIED; every other case is UNRESOLVED.
nodes.domain: One named target-domain, cell and optional measure certificate.
nodes.scope: One named target-domain, cell and optional measure certificate.
nodes.source_lineage: R169 calibration triage refined to separate domain closure from measure-weighted open-world certification.
nodes.proof: Priority logic is exhaustively checked over 32 Boolean assignments; theorem strength remains tied to the exact certified state.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: OPEN_WORLD_MASS_CERTIFIED is not weaker wording for amplitude closure; it deliberately retains sup_U e<=M only.

formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: validity first, then refutation, then closed or measure-weighted certification, else unresolved
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same T, cells, mu, effect and challenge plan
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Keep amplitude, mean and mass conclusions separately typed

nodes.label: R170 Refines Route-Coverage Claims Only
nodes.statement: If the complete R166-R169 witness and a valid R170 target/cell/remainder certificate hold on one common episode, closed-domain amplitude or open-world mean/mass conclusions may be used exactly as typed; no result establishes complete neural organization, derives C1 or B_min, adds a basal gate or selects an exclusive owner.
nodes.domain: One common actual P/I/K/D/rho episode, target domain and R166-R170 certificate package.
nodes.scope: One common actual P/I/K/D/rho episode, target domain and R166-R170 certificate package.
nodes.source_lineage: Conditional refinement of R169's application boundary with UCT-I physical-witness, overlap and semantic limits retained.
nodes.proof: Bind target, cells, remainder, measure and all earlier route objects to the same application and use only the conclusion licensed by the triage state.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A small remainder mass can coexist with a maximal rare effect; neither map/code success nor coverage statistics identify experience or familiar mineness.

formal_contract_R170.object_domain: one actual route witness plus target-domain remainder certificate
formal_contract_R170.quantifiers: every all-of premise on one application; no necessity, global mechanism or semantic conclusion
formal_contract_R170.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D/rho lineage, target, consumer, interval and signature across R166-R170
formal_contract_R170.purpose: Advance actual-organization evidence while preserving C1 and experience-internal mineness boundaries

rules.statement: The predeclared target and independently certified cell family jointly define the covered domain and explicit unresolved remainder.
rules.proof_sketch: Take the cell union inside T and retain its complement without assigning it zero effect.

rules.statement: The bounded effect, valid covered route envelope and explicit remainder jointly yield the sharp piecewise information-class envelope.
rules.proof_sketch: Use E_C on C and M on U; the piecewise upper function is the extremal information-class witness.

formal_contract_R170.quantification: every compatible effect and every z in T

rules.statement: A nonempty unresolved remainder plus the sharp piecewise envelope jointly preserve the global amplitude cap M as the best general bound.
rules.proof_sketch: Place effect M at one point of U; its measure is irrelevant to the supremum.

bindings_required: no extra pointwise bridge on U

rules.statement: The fixed target measure, explicit partition and pointwise envelope jointly yield the exact mean remainder bound.
rules.proof_sketch: Integrate the piecewise upper envelope under the same target measure.

rules.statement: The fixed target measure, explicit partition and pointwise envelope jointly bound threshold-exceedance mass by covered-envelope exceedance plus the remainder.
rules.proof_sketch: Apply the set inclusion {e>tau} subset {C and E_C>tau} union U and take mu.

rules.statement: The target, cell, explicit remainder and challenge contract jointly require five-way open-world status logic with distinct closed-amplitude and open-mass certified states.
rules.proof_sketch: Invalidity dominates, then valid refutation; proven closure supports amplitude, valid remainder mass supports only mean/exceedance, and the complement is unresolved.

bindings_required: closure and mass certificates kept distinct
formal_contract_R170.quantification: one certificate; one valid violation refutes; certification uses exact declared scope

rules.statement: The full R169 application and every R170 amplitude/mean/mass/status distinction jointly permit only the exactly typed open-world refinement on one actual episode.
rules.proof_sketch: Bind every object to one application, use the status-specific conclusion, and preserve all C1/B_min/basal/owner boundaries.

bindings_required: no reverse inference to C1/B_min/basal experience/unique owner
formal_contract_R170.quantification: every premise on one common application; no complete-mechanism inference

context_links.relation: context only: domain coverage refines physical evidence and does not replace C1 or B_min
obstruction retained: small or zero remainder mass does not imply a nontrivial pointwise amplitude bound
no target coverage, cell radius, measure or remainder clause is added to basal-experience existence
non-deductive application refinement: cell certificates can discharge continuum radius only when their universal physical range premise is valid
